columns.name: TRANSACTION_STATUS_ID
columns.description: Primary key to the table hry_pi_rti_transaction_status

columns.name: PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the table pay_pay_relationships_dn

columns.name: PAYROLL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the table per_all_payrolls_f

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the table per_all_people_f

columns.name: LEGISLATIVE_DATA_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the table per_legislative_data_groups

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the person fetched from ATOM Feed

columns.name: IS_ENQUEUED
columns.description: Status of whether the person is enqueued for processing

columns.name: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Response of the ADP Delivery API

columns.name: ITERATION_NO
columns.description: Count of the number of times ADP Response API has been hit

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Error Code generated from ADP Delivery API

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error Message generated from ADP Delivery API

columns.name: HIRE_DATE
columns.description: Hire Date for the new hire. This is equal to the Effective Start Date for the newhire.

columns.name: PAYROLL_ACTION_ID
columns.description: ID of the PAY_PAYROLL_ACTIONS table for the online extract run.

columns.name: EXTRACT_MODE
columns.description: Mode of the extract submission, for example, ONLINE or BATCH.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_SETUP_NAME
columns.description: Name of the integrator for which the newhire is processed.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of event for which the ATOM feed is analysed, for example, HIRE.

columns.name: FEED_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the infrastructure from where the data came into the table, e.g., ATOM, ESS.

columns.name: FEED_ENTRY_ID
columns.description: ID of the feed which comes as a response to the ATOM API call.

columns.name: FEED_ENTRY_UPD_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: Updated timestamp for the each of the new hire being preocessed. This is equal to the Effective Start Date for the newhire.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEGISLATION_CODE
columns.description: column used to store the Legislation Code of the payload

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: column used to store the file name of the payload

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: This column is intended to hold notification date of person's termination

columns.name: ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE
columns.description: This column is intended to hold actual termination date of person's termination
